title: Newsletter Bundle Component
description: Per-newsletter breakdown within a bundle product. Each component maps to a publisher_domain in the product's publisher_properties array and provides subscriber metadata and upcoming sendouts for that individual newsletter.

publisher_domain.description: The domain of the newsletter publisher. Must match a publisher_domain entry in the product's publisher_properties array.

name.description: Human-readable name of the newsletter (e.g., 'Finance Weekly')

subscriber_count.description: Number of active subscribers for this newsletter

avg_open_rate.description: Average open rate as a decimal (e.g., 0.45 for 45%)

avg_click_rate.description: Average click-through rate as a decimal (e.g., 0.03 for 3%)

avg_click_to_open_rate.description: Average click-to-open rate (CTOR) as a decimal — unique clicks divided by unique opens

send_frequency.description: How often this newsletter is sent

send_days.description: Days of the week this newsletter is typically sent

typical_send_time.description: Typical send time in HH:MM format (24-hour, publisher local time)

language.description: Primary language of this newsletter (BCP 47, e.g., 'en', 'de')

categories.description: IAB content taxonomy categories for this newsletter's editorial focus

upcoming_sendouts.description: Upcoming sendouts for this newsletter with available inventory
